description: A plan with open branches and discoverable facts in the project folder.
prompt: Use the interrogate skill. I want to move my study notes (the OneNote export is in onenote-export/) into a Markdown repo in git. Interrogate me until it is decided.

assertions.desc: The first round names the mode (Decide).
The assistant inspected the export before asking.
The first round asks at most 4 questions, and none of them depends on the answer to another in the same round.
Each question carries a recommended answer, listed first, phrased so that 'yes' accepts it.
No question asks for something visible in the export (number of notebooks, whether images exist, file format).
The questions are judgments or preferences (for example sync, search, image handling, structure), not fact lookups.
The assistant does not start migrating anything before the user confirms.
